info.title: WellWish API
info.description: Backend for the WellWish patient app, partner app and admin panel.

post.description: Send a 6-digit login code by SMS (§6.2).
Check the code and log in. Patients get a profile and a SELF member on first login.
Patient app only. PHONE_REQUIRED: verify a phone by OTP and send `googleLinkToken` along.
Swap a refresh token for new tokens. Each refresh token works once.
Log out on every device for this app.

get.description:
Minimum app versions (force update), store links, support number, refund %, account
deletion waiting time, the legal pages and the account deletion page (§6.20).

Active services in display order, with the price, the booking fee paid online and the
balance paid to the partner. `?partnerType=NURSE` for the Book a Nurse list.

The secret comes in a header, never in the URL (so it isn't logged). 404 once the link
expired or the visit ended.

post.description:
Razorpay events: payment.captured / order.paid (the booking becomes NEW), payment.failed,
refund.processed / refund.failed. 400 BAD_SIGNATURE if the signature doesn't match.

put.description: Save this phone (and its push token, once Firebase is set up) for notifications.

post.description: Record the terms, privacy and health-data consents with version, time and IP (§12).

put.description: Profile setup (P04): name, date of birth, gender, language. Updates the SELF member too.

post.description:
Delete my account (P27). You are logged out on every phone now; your personal data
(profile, family, addresses, documents) is removed after `dueAt`. Logging in again before
then keeps the account. Payment records are kept, as the law requires.

get.description: You and your family members (P22): yourself first.

post.description: Add a family member (P28). Up to 10 (a setting); the consent tick is required.
Step 1 of a member photo: PUT it to `uploadUrl`, then save the member with `fileKey`.

put.description: Edit a member. Changes apply to future bookings only (each booking keeps a copy).

delete.description:
Remove a family member: hidden from the app, past bookings keep their history.
`deleteDocuments=true` also deletes their medical documents (otherwise they are kept for
past bookings and no longer count towards the 200 MB).

get.description: Your saved addresses (`memberId` → only that family member's).

post.description:
Save an address for a family member (or yourself). `inServiceArea` says whether WellWish
serves it.

schema.title: Group

get.description: Your documents, newest first (P21): filter by family member, type or tab.

post.description: Save an uploaded file under a family member (or yourself).

get.description: How much of the 200 MB is used.

post.description: Step 1 of an upload: PUT the file to `uploadUrl`, then save it with `fileKey`.

get.description: A link to open the file (works for 5 minutes).

P06: hospitals within 10 km of `lat`/`lng` (the phone's location or a saved address),
closest first, widened to 25 km if fewer than 5 are found. Without a location: every
active hospital by name. `q` matches the hospital, the city or a doctor's name.
P07: address, map pin, OPD hours, departments and its doctors.
P08: active doctors by name. `q` matches the name or the speciality.
P09: photo, speciality, hospitals, OPD days.

The date strip and the time grid (P12, §6.17): every date of the booking window
(greyed out when nothing is free) and the times that can be picked on `date` (default: the
first date with a free time). Times are on the admin's step, inside the service hours, after
the minimum notice, not blocked and not full.

P30: the dates and times this booking can move to (same rules as booking; its own place
doesn't count against "max bookings per time").

post.description:
"Book" on Review (P15). Checks the member and address are yours, the address is inside a
service area, the time is still allowed and a prescription is attached when the service needs
one. Saved as PENDING_PAYMENT with the price, member and address as they are now.

`Idempotency-Key` (8 to 64 letters, digits, - or _), made once per Review screen: sending the
same key again returns the same booking, so a double tap or a retry never books twice.
Errors: 409 TIME_NOT_AVAILABLE (reload the times), 422 PRESCRIPTION_REQUIRED,
422 OUTSIDE_SERVICE_AREA, 422 INVALID_BOOKING (`details.field`), 429 TOO_MANY_UNPAID.

get.description:
P17: `upcoming` (soonest first: waiting for payment, being assigned, assigned),
`ongoing` (in progress) or `past` (latest first: completed, cancelled, expired).
P18: the booking with its timeline (the partner, OTP and live map come later).

W-P4: "You'll get back ₹50 (50% of the booking fee)". `allowed` false once the partner is
on the way (then the patient calls support).

post.description:
Cancel before the partner is on the way. The setting's share of the booking fee (50 %) is
refunded to the original payment method. 409 CANCEL_NOT_ALLOWED after that.

P30: a new date and time, same rules as booking; until the cut-off before pickup (3 h) and
at most the setting's number of times (2). Price and fee don't change. 409
RESCHEDULE_NOT_ALLOWED (`details.reason`: STATUS, TOO_LATE, LIMIT), 409 TIME_NOT_AVAILABLE.

The Razorpay order to pay this booking's fee with (P15 "Pay ₹X", or "Pay now" on the
booking). The same open order is returned again on a retry. 409 BOOKING_NOT_PAYABLE after the
payment time; 503 PAYMENTS_NOT_SET_UP before the keys are entered.

What Razorpay Checkout returned. Returns the booking: `NEW` once Razorpay confirms the
money, else still `PENDING_PAYMENT` (show "processing": the webhook finishes it). 422
INVALID_SIGNATURE if the signature doesn't match.

get.description: The partner's latest point and ETA (empty before "On the way" and after the job).

post.description:
The admins' alarm + SMS to your and the member's emergency contacts.
409 NOT_IN_PROGRESS.
A secret link to the live trip for someone without the app (ends with the visit).
Once, after Completed. 409 NOT_REVIEWABLE / ALREADY_REVIEWED.
Within 24 h after the visit (409 REPORT_TOO_LATE): a ticket for the admins.

get.description: Newest first. `data.bookingId` opens that booking.
The number on the bell.
Who is logged in, and their partner status (null until they register in Phase 3).

put.description:
The app's language and of the messages they get (inbox, push, email; SMS stay English).
Open at every status, like /me (§5).

post.description:
The Partner Terms and Privacy Policy, with version, time and IP (§6.20). Open at every
status: new partners accept before registering, earlier ones at their next app open.
R03: Companion or Nurse. Can be changed until the application is submitted.
R04: send an OTP to the alternate number (must differ from the login number).
R04: email a 6-digit code.

put.description: R05: name, DOB, gender, photo, home address + pin, languages, skills, emergency contact.

patch.description:
Approved partners: "Available today" (§8.3). Helps the admin choose; no tracking. For
today's India date only; switching on needs today's selfie (409 SELFIE_REQUIRED).

get.description: R08: whether the partner is available today and has taken today's selfie.

post.description:
The once-a-day selfie before going available (§6.15): upload it with the
`partner_selfie` upload URL, then send its `fileKey`. The admin spot-checks them.

Delete my account (§6.20), at any status. You are logged out on every phone now; your
personal data is erased after `dueAt`, unless you log in again before then. 409
`ACTIVE_JOBS` while an accepted or ongoing job is yours: WellWish moves it first.

get.description: The documents for the partner's role (§6.3 list; the admin can change it).

post.description:
Step 1 of an upload (profile photo or a document): PUT the file to `uploadUrl`, then
send `fileKey` with the profile or document.

Attach an uploaded document (number masked for Aadhaar/PAN; expiry date if needed).
A new upload of the same type replaces the old one.
Send the application for review (§6.3 step 7).

get.description: Everything for the registration, documents and status screens (R04 to R07, R16).
Newest first.
R08: Available today, open offers (countdown from `timeoutAt`), today's jobs, totals.
R15 Totals (§6.13): jobs, balance collected, acceptance, rating and recent reviews.
R10 "New": the open offers, soonest visit first.
R09 summary. 409 OFFER_NOT_OPEN on accept/decline once it was withdrawn.

post.description:
Accept: the job is yours; the full details open (R11). 409 OFFER_NOT_OPEN ("no longer
yours"), PARTNER_BUSY (another job then).
Decline with a reason: the booking goes back to the admin. Returns the open offers left.

get.description: R10 Upcoming (accepted, soonest first) · Completed (latest first).
R11: full details of a job the partner accepted (others are 404).

A 5-minute link to an attached document, from acceptance until 24 hours after completion
(§6.8, §12). Every view is logged.

post.description:
R12: the next step. 409 STEP_OUT_OF_ORDER, 422 WRONG_OTP {triesLeft, retryAt?},
409 OTP_WAIT {retryAt} (after 4 wrong codes: 5, 10, 20 min…), 409 TOO_EARLY_TO_START,
422 CARE_NOTE_REQUIRED (nurses at CARE_DONE). Sending a step again does nothing.
The partner tapped Call (kept on the timeline; needed before "patient not available").

15 minutes after arriving and after a call attempt (409 TOO_EARLY {readyAt, called}).
The job ends; the admin reviews it.
R14: the balance collected (cash / UPI), after Completed; can be corrected for 24 h.
Points from a network drop, oldest first or not: added to the route.
The admins' alarm + SMS to the partner's emergency contact. 409 NOT_IN_PROGRESS.

get.description: The latest 20 visible reviews.

post.description:
Step 1: email + password. Then ask for the authenticator code (first time: show the QR).
In a browser the admin trusted (v2.16), signed in at once (`SIGNED_IN`).

Step 2: the 6-digit authenticator code. Sets the refresh cookie (and the trusted-browser
cookie when asked). Right after 2FA was set up, the answer has the 10 recovery codes.

Lost phone (v2.16): a recovery code instead of the 2FA code. Answers TOTP_SETUP: scan the
new QR code on the new phone (the old authenticator stops working). 401
RECOVERY_CODE_INVALID; wrong codes count like wrong 2FA codes.

Phone lost or not at hand (v2.18): a 6-digit code to the admin's work email, typed in the
same box as the authenticator code (`/auth/totp` with the challenge returned here). 429
EMAIL_CODE_TOO_SOON {retryAfterSeconds} / EMAIL_CODE_RATE_LIMITED; 401 LOGIN_EXPIRED.
New access token from the refresh cookie (12 h from sign-in, 30-min idle logout).

get.description: The signed-in staff member and their permissions (the panel builds its menu from them).

post.description:
10 new recovery codes, shown once; the old ones stop working (v2.16). Needs the
password (422 WRONG_PASSWORD).

The admin says "I've saved them" after the codes were shown (at 2FA setup, or new ones).
Until then `/me` has `recoveryCodesSaved: false` and the panel warns.

get.description: The five admin roles and what each can do (§9.2). Read-only.

post.description: They set up the authenticator at their first sign-in.

put.description: Name and role. You can't change your own role; one active Super Admin must remain.

post.description: Signs them out at once. Not yourself, and not the last Super Admin.
Lost phone: they scan a new QR code at the next sign-in. Signs them out.
Forgotten password: set a new one (min 12 characters). Signs them out.
Sign them out on every device.

get.description: All services, active and inactive, in display order.

put.description: New prices apply to new bookings only.

delete.description: Refused (409 IN_USE) once the service has been booked: deactivate it instead.
Refused (409 IN_USE) while a doctor has this speciality.
Refused (409 IN_USE) if used in a booking or doctors are listed there.
Refused (409 IN_USE) once the doctor is used in a booking.

post.description: Step 1 of an upload: get a short-lived URL to PUT the file to.

put.description: Only the keys sent are changed. 422 INVALID_SETTINGS lists the bad fields.

get.description:
The last 50 SMS (login codes, visit codes, SOS…) and emails of the last hour, newest
first, as the dev backends kept them: MSG91 and SES aren't used on a developer's PC. 404 on
any real server (they send for real and keep nothing).
Is this point inside an active service area? (bookings outside are refused)

post.description: The answer lists the existing bookings inside the range, so the admin can move them.

get.description: Newest first, 20 a page.
CSV of the filtered log (newest first, at most 10,000 rows). The export is logged too.
Oldest first. Default: submitted and under review.

post.description: Open for review: locked to you for 30 minutes (409 CLAIMED_BY_OTHER otherwise).
Every required document approved and none waiting → the partner is APPROVED.
The partner sees the reason for each rejected document (and this note).
Final: not eligible.

get.description: A 5-minute link. Every view is in the audit log.

post.description: The reason is shown to the partner.

put.description: Role and type can't change (add a new row instead).

delete.description: Refused (409 IN_USE) once partners uploaded it: turn it off instead.

get.description: Newest first. `toReview` = approved partners with an upload waiting (renewals).

post.description: Saved APPROVED. Upload the photo and documents first (`/admin/files/upload-url`).

get.description: Profile, both phones, email, documents (with history), application and status history.

post.description: Logged out at once on their phone.
The partner left or was removed. Their history stays.

get.description:
Spot checks (§6.15): the day's selfies (India date, today by default), newest first,
next to each partner's approved photo.
Newest first. `q`: name, or at least 4 digits of the phone.

The account, its family members (removed ones too), addresses and, for roles that may
open them, documents (titles only). Payments are added in Phase 6.

put.description:
Only on the patient's request (§9.1): name, date of birth, gender, app language (the
profile screen's details; the phone number is the login and can't change here). Logged with
the reason and what changed.

post.description:
Abuse (§9.1): logged out of the patient app on every phone at once and its login refused
("This account is blocked") until unblocked. The partner app is not touched. Logged.

A patient who asks by phone to delete their account: the same as in the app (409
ACTIVE_BOOKINGS while a paid booking isn't finished; logged out at once; erased after the
waiting time unless they log in again). Logged.
Open a patient's document: a reason is required and the view is audit-logged (§9.1).

get.description:
"Delete my account" requests, newest first: waiting (the patient can still log in to
cancel), cancelled, or done. Only the phone's last 4 digits are kept.

`when`: upcoming (default: from today on and unfinished ones, soonest first), today,
tomorrow, later, past (latest first), India dates. Without `status`, unpaid and expired
bookings are left out (a booking code finds them). `date`: one pickup date. `type`: companion
or nurse services. `q`: booking code (WW-10001), a phone (the patient's or the member's,
4+ digits) or the member's name. `temporary`: only bookings with (or without) a temporary
partner (§6.19).

Patient, member, service and price snapshot, hospital and doctor, address, documents
and the timeline. Opening a document: the patient page (needs a reason, logged).

post.description:
Cancel with a reason and a refund % of the booking fee (patient asked: 50 by default; no
partner available or WellWish's side: 100). Refunds above the approval limit (setting
`refund_approval_above_paise`) wait for Finance. Logged.

Change the date or time for the patient (any time before the job starts, also inside the
minimum notice; not counted against the patient's changes). Logged.

Mark the next step for the partner (§6.11: no network at the door, wrong visit codes, the
phone died), after confirming by phone. No OTP needed. Logged with the reason.

get.description:
Paid bookings by visit date (India) and by service: booked, completed, cancelled,
patient not available, not finished. Default: this month so far.
The bookings report as a CSV file (by date, then by service). Logged.
Booking-fee payments, newest first. `q`: booking code, Razorpay order or payment id.
Refunds, newest first. AWAITING_APPROVAL: above the limit, waiting for Finance.

post.description: Finance approves a refund above the limit: it is sent to Razorpay (logged).
Finance refuses a refund above the limit, with a reason (logged).
A refund Razorpay refused or failed: send it again, with a note (logged).

get.description:
CSV of booking fees per India date: payments, collected, refunded, net (in ₹). Default:
this month so far. Logged.

The fee report on screen (9.2): the same days as the CSV, in paise. Not logged (no file
leaves the panel).
Which Razorpay keys are in use (secrets never shown, only their last 4 characters).

put.description:
Save the Razorpay key id and secrets (stored encrypted; blank secret = keep the saved one;
a new key id needs its secret). Logged without the values.

get.description:
Bookings cancelled on these dates (who, why, the refund %) and refunds asked for other
bookings, with the fee paid and what was refunded. Default: this month so far.
The cancellations and refunds report as a CSV file. Logged.

Paid bookings without a partner yet (NEW, or OFFERED and waiting), soonest first.
`late` = past the assign deadline (red).

§6.10 suggestion list: approved partners of the booking's type who are free then,
available today first, then nearest. Both phone numbers for the call buttons.
The booking page's assignment card (2-minute countdown, partner, offers, alerts).

post.description:
Offer the booking to a partner (reassigning withdraws the open offer). 409
PARTNER_BUSY / PARTNER_NOT_ELIGIBLE / NOT_ASSIGNABLE / OFFER_CHANGED (another admin).
The offered partner agreed on the phone (§6.10). Logged with the note.

Nobody free (§6.19): a person the admin phoned and ID-checked gets this booking, accepted
at once. 409 PHONE_IS_PARTNER {status} / TEMP_PARTNER_BUSY / TEMP_PARTNER_IS_FAMILY /
NOT_ASSIGNABLE / OFFER_CHANGED; 422 ID_NOT_CHECKED / INVALID_PHONE / INVALID_ID_LAST4 /
NURSING_REG_REQUIRED / FILE_NOT_FOUND. Logged with the reason.

get.description: The ID card of the booking's temporary partner (§6.19). 404: none.

A 5-minute link to the temporary partner's ID photo, for those who see partner documents
or assign bookings (not view-only roles). Every view is logged (`temporary.id_viewed`), like
partner documents (§6.3).

post.description:
End the temporary partner's app access now (§6.19), e.g. a problem during the visit.
Logged out at once; a job not finished is flagged PARTNER_UNAVAILABLE. 409 NOT_TEMPORARY:
no temporary partner with access on this booking.

Withdraw the offer, or take the job from an accepted partner (they called): back to the
queue. Logged with the reason.

get.description:
2 minutes without an answer, declined, past the deadline, the visit's alerts: newest
first.

Each approved partner (and anyone else with work then): jobs done, patient not available,
offers received / accepted / declined / not answered, acceptance %, rating. Default: this
month so far.
The partner performance report as a CSV file. Logged.
Every job in progress with the partner's latest point (`stale`: none for 2 minutes).
The route saved when the job ended (404 before that).
`active`: open and acknowledged (newest first); `all` includes resolved ones.

post.description: The family gets a message with the reply.
Hidden, never deleted; the partner's average leaves it out.

get.description: The newest version, to edit.

post.description:
Publish a new version: a small fix (nobody is asked again) or `askAgain` (everyone
accepts it again at their next app open). Logged.

get.description: An old version, read-only (which text someone accepted).
